# Bundled Office preview font

`NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf` is the Simplified Chinese regular face from the
official [Noto CJK](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk) project. It is used
only by the server-side LibreOffice preview converter so Word, Excel and
PowerPoint previews do not depend on fonts installed on the host machine.
